PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
